name: RC-B10-0074/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia's war against Ukraine and rejects Russia's false historical claims used to justify it. It asks Russia to withdraw all forces from Ukraine and release deported Ukrainians, especially children. It calls for a special tribunal to prosecute Russian leaders for aggression, more sanctions on Russian media spreading disinformation, and stronger enforcement of EU rules against social media platforms. It also urges EU countries to teach Europe's shared history, ban Nazi and Soviet symbols, and build a memorial in Brussels for victims of totalitarian regimes.

- The EU is asked to sanction more Russian disinformation media and enforce platform rules.
- Russia is urged to withdraw from Ukraine and free deported civilians and children.
- EU countries are urged to ban Nazi and Soviet symbols and fund history education.
